# Otter Outfitters

> An outdoor gear demo store that welcomes personal AI agents through the Personal Agent Protocol (Poppy 1.0). Sample data only; no real payments.

## For agents
- [Poppy discovery](/.well-known/poppy.json): this store's identity, issuer and scopes
- [Protected resource metadata](/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource)

## Shopping
- [Catalog](/): every product, with photos and prices. Each product links to /products/<id>
- [Search](/search?q=dry%20bag): `/search?q=<words>` lists matching products
- [Cart](/cart), [checkout](/checkout) (pays with a simulated test card) and [orders](/orders)

## Rules
- You can browse as a guest. Check the API's agent policy to see whether the customer needs to sign in before starting a cart.
- Checking out needs the customer to approve you on the store's sign-in page; you then continue in their account.
- Agents can't change account details such as the name, email or password.
- The customer can see and disconnect you at /agents.
